"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Americans stated that America needs a new bold and sustainable energy policy to meet current challenges.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"America has been stirred to action when faced with new threats to national security or new competitive conditions.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The energy threat America faces today is as real and dangerous as threats from dictators.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The opportunities that would come with change in energy policy eclipse the dangers.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Jobs of the 21st Century will be created in developing new energy solutions.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The question is whether these jobs will be created in America or abroad.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Government procurement policies should incentivize domestic production of clean and renewable energy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Countries like Germany, Spain and Brazil have reaped economic growth benefits from clean energy.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"America is decades behind in confronting the energy challenge.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
